import { html } from 'common-tags'

export const registryItem = {
  type: 'registry:ui',
  name: 'date-picker',
  title: 'DatePicker',

  description: html`
    A date picker component that combines a popover trigger with an inline
    calendar for date selection.

    References:
    - Headless API: https://ark-ui.com/docs/components/date-picker
    - shadcn/ui: https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/date-picker
  `,

  dependencies: [
    '@ark-ui/vue',
    '@iconify/vue',
    '@internationalized/date',
    '@vueuse/core',
  ],

  registryDependencies: [
    'button',
    'calendar',
    'popover',
  ],
}

export default registryItem

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { DateValue } from '@internationalized/date'

import { ref } from 'vue'

import { DatePicker } from '@/components/ui/date-picker'

const date = ref<DateValue>()
</script>

<template>
  <DatePicker.Root v-model="date">
    <DatePicker.Trigger />
    <DatePicker.Content />
  </DatePicker.Root>
</template>
